title: Koodathil case: Crime Branch uncovers crucial evidence in mysterious death of Jayamadhavan Nair
description: The probe team has found crucial evidence against the family’s former caretaker, Raveendran Nair, the prime accused in the case;  the deaths of the members of the Koodathil family over a period of 26 years from 1991 had piqued interest, considering its eerie resemblance with the Koodathayi serial murder case in which a woman had allegedly murdered six people in Kozhikode over a span of 14 years.
